name: io.rugmunch/pry
title: Pry — Web Scraping, Browser Automation & Data Intelligence MCP
description: Self-hosted web intelligence MCP: scrape, crawl, extract, monitor, parse, screenshot, x402 pricing, plus ten data domains (crypto, marketplace, legal, real estate, jobs, travel, attention, local, gov, ip).

tools.name: pry_scrape
tools.description: Scrape any URL to clean markdown with a 9-tier anti-bot fallback chain (Cloudflare bypass).

tools.name: pry_crawl
tools.description: Crawl a website from a seed URL, discovering and scraping linked pages up to max_pages.

tools.name: pry_extract
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a URL using CSS selectors — cheaper than LLM extraction.

tools.name: pry_template
tools.description: Execute one of 110+ pre-built scraper templates (amazon, walmart, linkedin, etc.).

tools.name: pry_search_templates
tools.description: Search the scraper template catalog by keyword, category, or site name.

tools.name: pry_monitor
tools.description: Create a content-change monitor that notifies via webhook, Slack, or Discord.

tools.name: pry_compliance
tools.description: Score scraping legal risk from robots.txt, ToS, GDPR/CCPA, and PII exposure.

tools.name: pry_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a URL with company info, tech stack detection, and social profiles.

tools.name: pry_parse_document
tools.description: Parse a document (PDF, DOCX, image) and extract its text and tables.

tools.name: pry_screenshot
tools.description: Take a full-page screenshot of a URL and return it as a base64-encoded PNG.

tools.name: pry_x402_pricing
tools.description: Get current x402 pay-per-call pricing in USDC atomic units per tool.

tools.name: pry_referrals
tools.description: Get Pry's referral catalog — 60+ providers with revenue-attribution links.

tools.name: pry_token_launches
tools.description: Track recent token launches, deployer activity, and new mint intelligence (crypto).

tools.name: pry_cex_listings
tools.description: Monitor CEX listing announcements and delisting events for crypto tokens (crypto).

tools.name: pry_token_security
tools.description: Run token security checks — honeypot, mint authority, LP lock, holder distribution (crypto).

tools.name: pry_amazon_product
tools.description: Look up a single Amazon product by ASIN — live price, title, availability, rating (marketplace).

tools.name: pry_amazon_search
tools.description: Search Amazon by keyword and return matching listings with price, rating, ASIN (marketplace).

tools.name: pry_walmart_product
tools.description: Look up a single Walmart product by product ID — price, title, seller, rating (marketplace).

tools.name: pry_tiktok_trending
tools.description: Get currently trending TikTok Shop products by engagement and sales velocity (marketplace).

tools.name: pry_legal_dockets
tools.description: Search U.S. federal and state court dockets by full-text query via CourtListener (legal).

tools.name: pry_legal_sec
tools.description: Search SEC EDGAR filings by ticker and form type — filing dates, forms, accession numbers (legal).

tools.name: pry_legal_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or entity against the OFAC SDN sanctions list (legal).

tools.name: pry_realestate_search
tools.description: Search real-estate listings by location and status — price, beds/baths, sqft (real estate).

tools.name: pry_jobs_list
tools.description: List ATS job postings for a company — Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday (jobs).

tools.name: pry_jobs_salary
tools.description: Get per-level salary bands (total comp, base, stock, bonus) from Levels.fyi (jobs).

tools.name: pry_flights_grid
tools.description: Cheapest flight per day over a date range for an origin/destination pair (travel).

tools.name: pry_hotel_rates
tools.description: Per-night hotel rates for a stay window — Google Hotels with Booking.com fallback (travel).

tools.name: pry_serp
tools.description: Scrape a Google SERP — organic results, AI Overview, People Also Ask (attention).

tools.name: pry_trends
tools.description: Google Trends interest over time plus related queries (attention).

tools.name: pry_places_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps for local businesses — name, rating, address, place IDs (local).

tools.name: pry_reviews
tools.description: Full review history for a place from Google Maps or Yelp, beyond the 5-review cap (local).

tools.name: pry_procurement
tools.description: Search U.S. federal procurement opportunities from SAM.gov (gov).

tools.name: pry_recalls
tools.description: Search recent CPSC/FDA product recalls (gov).

tools.name: pry_patents
tools.description: Search U.S. patents by keyword via USPTO/Google Patents (ip).

tools.name: pry_trademarks
tools.description: Search U.S. trademarks by keyword or owner via USPTO (ip).
